name: collective government
note: collective government, no single ruler (commune); intermittent lords: Biordo Michelotti 1393-1398, Gian Galeazzo Visconti 1400-1402, Braccio da Montone 1416-1424, Baglioni family 1438-1540; in 1540 the city was captured by Pier Luigi Farnese and deprived of its privileges (papal rule)
